name: real_ind1_pv2010_jplhi
description: All-real-shape scenario: FEC = German industrial plant LG1 (spiky: annual max = 1.7x mean weekday daily max; weekends ~1/3) from Zenodo 3899018 (2016, 15-min), DST rows removed, wall-clock time, weekday-aligned to 2025, affinely rescaled (weekday-night median -> 35 kW, annual max -> 990 kW); FNE = PVGIS-SARAH3 2010 (organiser method); EV = JPL sessions ['1-1-193-819', '1-1-178-828', '1-1-194-821', '1-1-193-827'] rescaled to 9.33 MWh.
